freeze_scope: Prospective minimal screening protocol for Q33 candidates; historical Q31/Q32 baselines were observed before this freeze, not a retrospective PASS gate
objective: Prioritize local generation speed while screening for substantial visible/audible degradation. Original, Turbo, Trim and other explicitly identified candidates are eligible. No universal numeric quality-loss threshold has been accepted.

current_scenario.prompt: A small red toy car drives slowly from left to right across a wooden table. Static camera, continuous motion. Audio: a quiet motor hum.
current_scenario.reference: Q32 unpruned original INT8,50 Euler/simple,video shift12/audio3; a practical local reference, not a BF16 quality oracle
current_scenario.historical_fast_candidate: Q31 Trim NVFP4,8 res_multistep/simple,video shift10/audio3,Kitchen/VSA graph; multi-component recipe comparison
current_scenario.shared_components: Historical graphs use the same saved conditioning and original INT8 videoVAE/native FP32 audioVAE filenames; actual asset identity must remain bound by receipts
current_scenario.scope_limit: One short low-resolution scenario only; no inference to native-resolution,long-clip or universal quality. Same seed across changed model/sampler does not imply identical trajectories.

before_each_candidate: Freeze candidate graph,exact model/LoRA/VAE/TE hashes,code identity,quantization,steps,sampler,scheduler,shifts,attention request and actual backend/fallback observations.

Preserve same prompt,conditioning,seed,geometry and audio expectation; declare intentional recipe changes. Do not silently switch components or claim a single-cause speedup when multiple components change.
Retain existing resource,timeout,ownership and cancellation gates. Do not lower them for a quality/speed win; check remaining quota before dispatch.
Record cold/warm/reused-conditioning state,system co-load and timestamped timing scope. A missing phase time is null; tqdm adjusted display is not wall latency.

automatic_structure_checks.method: Reuse unchanged frozen media decoder and gate identities; bind candidate MP4 SHA and full decode result. No new quality metric package.
required_facts: Input SHA stable and complete demux/decode to EOF without corrupt frame or decode failure
Declared and decoded geometry/frame count/rate agree with this scenario
Video finite and neither all-black nor spatially/temporally constant; record diagnostics instead of inventing realism scores
Audio stream exists,decodes fully,has expected channels/rate,and finite nonzero samples; report duration,start/end offsets,RMS/extrema as observations
Record stream codecs,timebases,MP4 bytes,frame extraction identities and worker cleanup
automatic_structure_checks.interpretation: Structure eligibility only; finite/nonzero audio does not prove motor-hum semantics,pleasantness or perceptual synchronization. File size,RMS,adjacent RGB differences,PSNR orSSIM are not standalone cross-model quality ranks.
automatic_structure_checks.failed_structure: Do not select as a speed winner; preserve evidence. Overall quality remains INCONCLUSIVE if evaluation is incomplete.

perceptual_screen.required_review: Play each complete3.04s clip at24fps with sound,then compare reference/candidate in both orders at the same player volume and display size. Use neutral labels when practical; record if reviewer knew model identity.
perceptual_screen.stills: Use native unmodified frames0,36,72 to localize observations. Stills alone leave temporal and audio fields unreviewed. If a defect is reported,record exact frame/time span; do not cherry-pick only best frames.

rubric.questions: Red toy car,wooden tabletop,left-to-right slow travel,static camera,quiet motor hum; report wrong/missing requested content. Different car styling is not automatically degradation.
Does the car remain recognizably the same object? Check shape,wheels,body parts,table contact and unexpected duplication/disappearance. Record visible severity,not a numeric loss percentage.
Does movement look continuous and coherent across the full clip? Check freezing,teleporting,jumps,reversal or abrupt unrequested cuts; distinguish changed travel distance from corruption.
Check obvious flicker,exposure pumping,ghost trails,smearing and geometry morphing; isolate their times and distinguish intended motion blur.

Listen for quiet motor hum rather than missing/overwhelming/unrequested speech ornoise; check clicks,dropouts,distortion and obvious audiovisual mismatch. Numeric timestamps do not settle perceptual synchronization.
Is the candidate usable for this requested clip despite differences? Record user acceptance separately from assistant screening.

perceptual_screen.ranking_rule: After structure checks,only candidates with completed local perceptual review and no observed obvious major defect may be shortlisted by like-for-like measured request time. Pending viewing/listening remains conditional; do not describe as quality-equivalent. User selects acceptable tradeoff. A visible major defect cannot be erased by averaging other rubric items.
perceptual_screen.campaign_claim: Local screening does not establish L3 general quality orL4 service performance; campaign verdict remains INCONCLUSIVE absent the broader accepted gates.

historical_evidence_reuse.allowed: Reuse valid MP4/decode/conditioning/source identities and existing observations. Avoid regenerating baselines solely to recreate evidence already present.
historical_evidence_reuse.not_allowed: Historical one-off11.23s Trim and237.14s original prompt logs are separate unpaired observations,not a controlled service speedup orpure sampling comparison. Do not add prior TE runtime to fabricate a fresh end-to-end run.

suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.tests: Fast motion,object identity,contact deformation,ghost trails,event/audio correspondence
suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.notes: Use same384x256/73f/24fps/seed424242 across candidate recipes; encode this prompt once then bind a new conditioning hash. Do not reuse the toycar conditioning.

suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.prompt: An adult sitting at a table slowly lifts a blue ceramic mug with both hands and gives a small smile. Static waist-up camera, continuous shot. Audio: a light ceramic sound as the mug leaves the table and a quiet room, no speech.
suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.tests: Human identity,hands and object contact,small facial motion,structural consistency
suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.notes: At this low resolution,report unreadable fine details as limited evidence; do not invent precise anatomy scores. New shared conditioning required.

suggested_next_prompts_not_executed.notes: Only after the first two and quota/resource allowance; text legibility at384x256 is a stress case,not a universal quality rejection rule. New shared conditioning required.
